messages:
maria: Heads-up — milk jug in the fridge leaked this morning, tiny puddle by the door. If you moved it, ty. I left a note.
ben: Oh no, thanks for cleaning. Which milk was it?
maria: Oatmilk (Oatly carton) — cap didn't close. I moved it to the top shelf in a ziplock. Please check your mugs if anything smells funky.
rachel: Can we start a 'mug signal' system? like leave your mug handle out vs in = available? :raised_hand:
kyle: Or a sticker on the mug rack? Also need to restock sugar pods and decaf beans. Who's on coffee duty this week?
sarah: :wave: I'm on this week. I'll pick up sugar and decaf (the dark roast is still fine). Any brand prefs? Ping me if you want anything specific.
ben: Thanks Sarah! Also, there's a lone espresso portafilter in sink 3. Please don't run the steam wand with it inside or we cry.
maria: :laughing: noted. I also left a 6-pack of kombucha in the fridge labeled 'for snack table' — someone took 1 without note, it's OK :)
ops-bot: Reminder: Kitchen inventory low: sugar_pods=4, oatmilk_cartons=1, decaf_packs=0. Auto-order disabled. Use /kitchen-order or PM @sarah.
rachel: Can we standardize on leaving a sticky note with name + item? saves 'who took it' mysteries.
kyle: Also microwave etiquette: please cover food + set 30s default. Tired of open lasagna explosions.
maria: Proposal: coffee duty buys refills (milk, sugar, decaf) + posts receipts in #finance for reimbursement. OK?
finance-bot: Expense note: tag receipts with 'kitchen' + date. Quick tip: use `scan-receipt` to upload.
sarah: sgtm. I can take the receipt today. I'll grab Oatly x2, decaf beans (cafe-quality), sugar pods (1 box) and a box of napkins.
ben: If anyone wants a cookie run at 3pm, count me in.
rachel: :cookie: I'll bring my famous salted brown butter cookies. 3pm central table.
maria: Legend. Also can someone move the labeled 'Conference snacks' box out of sink area? it's triggering sink drama.
kyle: On it after lunch.
ben: PS: quick inventory list to copy: `milk, oatmilk, decaf, sugar, napkins, coffee filters`
rachel: adding 'dish brush' — the old one lost its head.
maria: :thumbsup: thanks y'all. I'll update the shared 'kitchen inventory' doc.
